title: Walk in the Light! So Shalt Thou Know
description: Walk in the Light! So Shalt Thou Know in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Bernard Barton wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 998 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"Walk in the Light."”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Walk in the light! so shalt thou know That fel-low-ship of love, His Spir-it on-ly can be-stow, Who reigns in light a-bove.

lines: Walk in the light! so shalt thou know
Walk in the light! and thou shalt own
Because that light hath on thee shone
Walk in the light! and e'en the tomb
Glory shall chase away its gloom,
Walk in the light! and thine shall be
For God, by grace, shall dwell in thee,

licence: Public domain: Bernard Barton died in 1849.
credits: Words by Bernard Barton (1784–1849), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
